$description: GLINR design tokens. Framework-neutral source of truth; run `npm run tokens` in web/ to regenerate the CSS. A plain $value is mode independent; {light, dark} is mode aware. A {group.name} string aliases another token. $extensions.glinr.name pins a legacy CSS name, $extensions.glinr.tailwind emits a Tailwind v4 theme variable.

surface.$description: Raised surface such as a card or panel.

border-strong.$description: Emphasised border for inputs and dividers that must read at a glance.

grid-line.$description: Faint structural rule, for grid lines and section dividers.

accent.$description: The single accent, driven by the runtime brand. Use for focus, links and one primary mark per view.

highlight.$description: 1px top inner highlight that keeps dark surfaces readable.

page-gap.$description: Vertical gap between page sections (compact default).

page-gap-comfortable.$description: Page gap when data-density is comfortable.

card-pad-comfortable.$description: Card padding when data-density is comfortable.

section-pad.$description: Vertical padding of a form section (compact default).

section-pad-comfortable.$description: Form section padding when data-density is comfortable.

banner-pad-comfortable.$description: Banner padding when data-density is comfortable.

hero-tile.$description: Brand tile edge in a page hero. One value for every density.

hero-tile-comfortable.$description: Kept for compatibility, equals hero-tile so the hero never changes size with density.

control-h.$description: Height of buttons, inputs and selects (compact default).

control-h-comfortable.$description: Control height when data-density is comfortable.

row-h-comfortable.$description: Table row height when data-density is comfortable.

table-header-h-comfortable.$description: Table header height when data-density is comfortable.

badge-h-comfortable.$description: Badge height when data-density is comfortable.

max.$description: Default page content width, fluid below it and centered above it.

max-wide.$description: Wide page content width for tables and dashboards.

page-pad-x.$description: Symmetric left and right padding of the page column from md up.

aside.$description: Width of the right rail slot in PageTemplate from xl up.

aside-top.$description: Sticky offset of the right rail inside the scrolling main column.

lg.$description: Default radius for cards and panels.

control.$description: Corner radius of buttons, inputs and selects. Follows the radius appearance setting.

header.$description: Sticky header once content scrolls under it.

body.$value: 'Geist', 'Geist Fallback', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
body.$description: Body copy. Geist with a metric-adjusted fallback so the swap does not shift layout.

display.$value: 'Geist', 'Geist Fallback', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

eyebrow.$value: 'Geist Mono', 'Geist Mono Fallback', ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace

sans.$value: 'Geist', 'Geist Fallback', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

mono.$value: 'Geist Mono', 'Geist Mono Fallback', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
mono.$description: Default monospace stack for code, logs and ids.

display-weight.$description: Light weight, only for numerals and display sizes of 28px or more.

label-weight.$description: Weight for controls and table headers.

heading-weight.$description: Page, section and banner title weight.

greeting-weight.$description: Dashboard greeting, sign-in and setup heading weight.

leading-section.$description: Card and section title line height.

size-greeting.$description: Dashboard greeting, sign-in and setup headings.

tracking-display.$description: Display letter spacing, matches the sign-in showcase.

numeric-features.$description: font-variant-numeric for metrics, counts and tables so digits align.

ease.$description: Standard easing, fast start and soft landing.

ease-spring.$description: Spring easing for sheets, popovers, toggles and press.

press-scale.$description: Scale applied while a control is pressed.

custom-width.$description: Default of the user content width override, set live by the appearance settings.

text-scale.$description: Default text size percentage, set live by the appearance settings.

accent-light.$description: Default custom accent in light mode, set live by the appearance settings.

accent-dark.$description: Default custom accent in dark mode, set live by the appearance settings.

surface-overlay.$description: Menus, dialogs and the glass tint base.

surface-glass-solid.$description: Opaque fallback for glass when blur or transparency is unavailable.

border-control.$description: Field edge, at least 3:1 on raised.

accent-solid.$description: Accent fill, rails and selected edges.

success-fg.$description: success text on its soft fill.

warning-fg.$description: warning text on its soft fill.

danger-fg.$description: danger text on its soft fill.

info-fg.$description: info text on its soft fill.

neutral-fg.$description: neutral text on its soft fill.

thin.$description: Floating sidebar over the fixed backdrop.

regular.$description: Top bar, toasts, bulk bar, menus.

tinted.$description: Bulk bar while a selection is active.

ultrathin.$description: Backdrop blur for the ultrathin material.

thin.$description: Backdrop blur for the thin material.

regular.$description: Backdrop blur for the regular material.

thick.$description: Backdrop blur for the thick material.

tinted.$description: Backdrop blur for the tinted material.

ultrathin.$description: Backdrop saturation for the ultrathin material.

thin.$description: Backdrop saturation for the thin material.

regular.$description: Backdrop saturation for the regular material.

thick.$description: Backdrop saturation for the thick material.

tinted.$description: Backdrop saturation for the tinted material.

rest.$description: Resting card shadow. Dark modes use an edge instead.

glass-edge.$description: 1px rim colour of a glass surface.

specular.$description: Top inner highlight of a glass surface.

glass-inner.$description: Soft inner shade of a glass surface.
